text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not feeling very well, I stopped by the infirmary, where I found Sakura Chitose O.
choice_data_list: Oh? Are you here as well?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Yes... My leg has become slightly swollen... And you are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she was asking in return—
we heard a loud shout coming from outside.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*............
—Not yet, not by a long shoooooot!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu... We cannot afford to fall behind either. Let's go, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You don't need to tell me, I was already planning on it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them sprinted off with great energy.
—All of them are classmates in the same year as Sakura Chitose O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her peers pushing one another to greater heights.
Meanwhile, her own body unable to run.
I assumed she would feel frustrated, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: ...Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
My, how wonderful... So very healthy and robust...
Hoho... A truly fine thing... A fine thing indeed...
choice_data_list: Um, well... aren't you feeling anxious?
Um, well... aren't you worried at all?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
...Anxious...?
—Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Not in the least...
In all matters, an absence of desire is essential...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Giving in to greed... rushing things along—and meddling in this and that is a poor strategy... Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: For now, one must take things easy and gentle...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wasn't putting on a brave face; she was genuinely at peace.
So much so that it felt downright mysterious...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of a mock race.
Participating were all members of BNW, and—Sakura Chitose O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Hoho... What lovely weather we are blessed with...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having suffered consecutive setbacks, she was noticeably lacking in race practice compared to her peers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hello, Chitose O-kun. It seems your condition has returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still... your leg was hurting, wasn't it?! You mustn't push yourself too hard, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern...
However, I have fully recovered...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I watched their exchange, the mock race soon got underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right away, the other horse girls galloped ahead smoothly. However, Sakura Chitose O remained far behind in the rear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gap made it seem as though she had been completely left behind.
Perhaps the lack of real race practice had taken its toll... Just as I thought that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: *inhale*...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAHHHHH—————!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chitose O accelerated all at once!
With an explosive closing burst and a surging charge, she swept along the wide outside—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! What kind of absurd chase is that—?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: First across the finish line is Sakura Chitose O!! Sakura Chitose Ooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Thank you for your kind congratulations...
Yet, this too is merely the natural order of things...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
The highest virtue is like water—
Even a modest trickle, should it flow continuously, will eventually pierce stone...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Even so. Under normal circumstances, one could hardly remain as composed as you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Your extraordinary perseverance is truly something to learn from—I was reminded of that once again, Chitose O-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thus, through her extraordinary courage and serene composure, she seized victory.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you foresaw this outcome from the start?
Could it be you foresaw this result all along?
I really want to learn from that sheer courage...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thus, through her extraordinary courage and serene composure, she seized victory.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you foresaw this outcome from the start?
Could it be you foresaw this result all along?
I really want to learn from that sheer courage...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Hoho... Hohohoho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without uttering another word, she walked away.
The way her figure disappeared beyond the cloud of dust was just like a hermit sage...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I asked her what I could do to become more like her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I asked her what one could do to become more like her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well then—
Please gaze upon the sky...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Just like that...
For a while... stay as you are—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Still a bit more...
Until the sun goes down... just like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Staring up at the sky for several hours—it was mind-numbingly boring, but she seemed completely unbothered. Once again, I felt like I had glimpsed the true vastness of her vessel...
